method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stocks Fall as Oil Rally Fuels Inflation Fears: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Broad market wrap highlighting oil-driven inflation fears and equity downside — dominant macro risk (oil/geopolitics -> higher inflation/yields) pushing risk-off sentiment across equities.

Equities.title: Stocks dented by inflation risk from rising oil, dicey geopolitics
Equities.reason: Confirms market narrative that rising oil and geopolitical uncertainty are weighing on risk assets — meaningful negative for broad equity risk sentiment.

Equities.title: U.S. Energy Secretary Wright says Iran nuclear deal may never happen
Equities.summary: Iran warned of faster, heavier retaliation against U.S. attacks while acknowledging the war’s mounting toll on its economy.
Equities.reason: Geopolitical escalation risk (Iran/no deal) implies sustained oil-risk premium and uncertainty — negative for global equities via inflation and risk-off flows.

Equities.title: Indian shares on track for muted open as oil climbs on rising Mideast risks
Equities.reason: Regional equity reaction to rising oil and Middle East tensions — illustrates market transmission of oil/geopolitics into EM/Asia equities (muted/negative).

Equities.title: Oil prices climb, Dow futures sink on reports of Saudi Aramco refinery being hit
Equities.reason: Reported supply disruption (Aramco refinery hit) lifts oil risk premium and triggers equity futures selloff — direct negative for market risk appetite.

Equities.title: Dow futures fall 300 points to start shortened week as oil prices climb
Equities.reason: Illustrates immediate market reaction (futures weakness) to higher oil — short-term risk-off signal for US equities.

Equities.title: Japan’s Nikkei Rises as Tech Tailwinds Help Balance Macro Nerves
Equities.reason: Tech/AI leadership continues to provide a counterbalance to macro/geopolitical worries — positive for tech-heavy indexes and a key support to global equities.

Equities.title: Anthropic and OpenAI bankers push for top-tier credit ratings post-IPO
Equities.summary: Investment-grade designation would unlock cheaper financing for AI labs and their infrastructure partners
Equities.reason: Shows strengthening structural support for AI ecosystem (financing, lower funding costs) — positive for AI sector and market leadership narrative.

Equities.title: French A.I. Start-Up Mistral Raises $3.5 Billion as Part of Strategy Shift
Equities.reason: Large AI fundraising highlights continued investor appetite and capital flowing into AI — supportive for tech equities and growth leadership.

Equities.title: The Wall of Political and Economic Risks Is Growing
Equities.reason: Broad macro piece flagging cumulative political/economic risks — reinforces negative regime shift risk for equities and higher volatility expectations.

Equities.title: Global Markets’ Summer Lull to End as Volatility, Risks Mount
Equities.reason: Macro narrative that calm is breaking and volatility is returning — negative for complacent equity positioning and implied volatility repricing.

Equities.title: India Defense Stocks Rally on $11 Billion Arms Purchase Plan
Equities.reason: Geopolitical tensions boost defense sector — sector-positive micro narrative but limited market-wide impact.

Equities.title: Mercuria and Gunvor Profits More Than Double on War Volatility
Equities.reason: Trading houses benefit from energy market volatility — positive for specific energy/commodity names, limited broad equity signal beyond sector.

Equities.title: Old Mutual Profit Drops as US-Iran War Fallout Curbs Investments
Equities.reason: Earnings impact from geopolitical fallout highlights how war/uncertainty can dent financial sector investment activity — modest negative for parts of financials.

Equities.title: Global markets keep shrugging off shocks. Here's what could break that streak, according to HSBC
Equities.summary: Markets have shrugged off a barrage of shocks in recent years but that resilience may not last forever, according to HSBC.
Equities.reason: Market resilience noted but flagged as fragile — slight negative tilt reflecting risk of reversal if oil/geopolitics or macro surprise intensify.

Rates.title: Treasury yields face 4.8% test as fiscal risks threaten to spill into other assets
Rates.summary: Treasury yields face a test at 4.8%, with a sustained move above that potentially creating "meaningful problems" for other asset classes, said Miller Tabak.
Rates.reason: Direct, market-moving signal that US Treasury yields may push higher (4.8% test). Higher yields = negative for bond prices and raises cross-asset spillover risk; high relevance to the rates regime (higher-for-longer theme).

Rates.title: Six Charts That Explain Why Japan’s Bond Yields Are Surging
Rates.reason: JGB yield surge represents a regional driver of higher global yields and signals tightening/withdrawal of central-bank support; negative for bond prices and important for global rates spillovers.

Rates.title: Global Bond Rush Kicks Off in Asia With Banks Leading the Charge
Rates.reason: Headline suggests increased demand for bonds in Asia led by banks, which would support bond prices (yields down) regionally — a countervailing flow to broader yield-up narratives, but more localized in relevance.

Rates.title: No, Friday's jobs report hasn't materially boosted Fed rate hike odds
Rates.reason: Argues recent US jobs data did not appreciably raise Fed hike probabilities — modestly supportive for bond prices (limits near-term upside in yields). Lower relevance as it is a single-data assessment versus broader yield drivers.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar gains as US Dollar struggles despite rising Fed rate hike bets
FX.summary: USD/CAD extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around 1.3800 during the Asian hours on Tuesday. Analysts at HSBC caution that, despite the recent improvement in sentiment around the Fed’s anti-inflation stance, broader structural issues have
FX.reason: USD/CAD slipping reflects a weaker USD and firmer CAD. The piece links USD weakness and CAD outperformance (partly oil-linked), making it a medium-significance FX signal for CAD strength.

FX.title: US Dollar Index (DXY) struggles below 99.00, two-week low as traders eye US inflation data
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, remains under some selling pressure for the second straight day and drops to an over two-week low during the Asian session on Tuesday.
FX.reason: Broad DXY weakness is a primary USD-centric FX signal that supports gains in EUR/JPY/AUD/CAD and undermines USD-funded carry. High relevance because the DXY move is market-wide and ties into upcoming US inflation data.

FX.title: Euro holds steady above 1.1600 as markets brace for US inflation data and ECB rate decision
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair trades on a flat note around 1.1625 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. Traders prefer to wait on the sidelines ahead of the key US inflation data and the European Central Bank (ECB) interest rate decision later this week.
FX.reason: Low-volatility, data-waiting tone — slight tilt toward EUR strength as the USD is soft, but lack of fresh news keeps relevance low.

FX.title: Japanese Yen rises to seven-month high on BoJ rate hike bets
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair falls to around 153.50 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens to a seven-month high against the US Dollar (USD) amid growing expectations of a Bank of Japan (BoJ) interest-rate hike.
FX.reason: Clear, sizable JPY appreciation driven by faster BoJ tightening expectations. This is a major FX regime signal (carry unwind / policy shift) with high market impact.

FX.title: The yen's sudden surge is upsetting the carry trade faithful
FX.reason: Narrative of rapid yen appreciation unwinding carry trades — reinforces JPY strength and global FX flow disruption; important for risk and funding-sensitive pairs but more flow-focused than a policy headline.

FX.title: Japan's foreign reserves drop by a record $80 billion in August following yen intervention
FX.summary: Finance ministry data showed that Japan's official foreign reserves stand at $1.207 trillion, down from July's figure of $1.287 trillion.
FX.reason: Official intervention (large reserves change) confirms authorities are actively managing the yen — reinforces the JPY-strength story while signalling potential volatility and policy commitment; high relevance for FX.

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Surging oil prices lift Canadian Dollar
FX.summary: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) trades higher against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday. The USD/CAD pair is down 0.25% to near 1.3780 at the time of writing as the Loonie outperforms due to surging oil prices.
FX.reason: Technical/price-forecast piece linking higher oil to CAD strength. Forecast/technical content capped at lower relevance but supports CAD-outperformance narrative amid oil-driven flows.

FX.title: Australian Dollar remains steady following China’s Trade Balance data
FX.summary: AUD/USD halts its four-day winning streak, trading around 0.7210 during Asian hours on Tuesday. The pair holds ground following the release Trade Balance data from China, Australia’s close trading partner.
FX.reason: China trade data supporting a steady AUD via trade links; modest significance compared with the larger USD/JPY and DXY moves.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD jumps to near $67 amid drop in US Dollar, bond yields
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) is up 1.25% to near $67.00 during the Asian trading session on Tuesday.
Commodities.reason: Near-term bullish move for silver tied to USD weakness and lower yields. Typical price/technical piece for a precious metal — positive but limited market-structure impact (relevance capped for price-forecast coverage).

Commodities.title: Gold Edges Higher as Softer Dollar Offsets Tensions in Hormuz
Commodities.reason: Gold supported by softer USD and safe‑haven demand amid Middle East tensions. Macro-driven bullion bid has broader market implications for precious-metals complex, so relevance is above a pure intraday technical note.

Commodities.title: Copper Surges to All-Time High as Tariff Turmoil Rocks Market
Commodities.reason: Strong, broad bullish signal for industrial metals: all‑time highs driven by tight supply and tariff-related disruption. High relevance due to implications for base‑metals complex, industrial demand and reflation trades.

Commodities.reason: Higher LNG export volumes point to stronger external demand and tighter global gas balances — modestly bullish for natural gas/energy markets given rising capacity and demand flows.

Commodities.reason: Elevated refining margins (crack spreads) amplify gasoline and diesel price pressure — directly relevant to petroleum product markets (RBOB/gasoil) and consumer fuel-price narratives.

Commodities.title: Wheat Jumps as Russia Focused on Ukraine War Despite US Talks
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical concentration of Russian resources on the Ukraine conflict raises supply risk for wheat — material fundamental for the grains complex, hence high relevance and a clear bullish price impulse.

Commodities.title: Brent Oil Near $100 as Iran Says Hormuz Deal With Oman Close
Commodities.reason: Oil price upside tied to geopolitical developments around the Strait of Hormuz and Middle East risk premium — significant for crude markets and energy risk premia, therefore high relevance.

Commodities.title: China Oil Demand Revival Spurs Price Spikes From Congo to Brazil
Commodities.reason: Renewed Chinese oil demand is a major demand-side driver lifting prices globally — high relevance given China's size and cross‑border commodity flow impacts.

Commodities.title: Iraq Struggles to Sell Oil From Basra After Hiking Its Prices
Commodities.reason: Domestic pricing move appears to be weighing on Iraqi exports — a localized demand/flow hiccup that is modestly bearish for regional crude flows but lower relevance versus broader supply/demand drivers.

Crypto.reason: Macro tightening / higher-for-longer Fed expectations are a direct headwind for risk assets and crypto — significant market-level negative for BTC and altcoins.
